distribution: Pangxin, Medog, Xizang (1,270 m a.s.l.); abroad it is found in Giri, India.
soldier: Head deep yellow, the labrum concolorous, the antennae yellowish brown with the tip slightly darker, the anterior half of the mandibles dark brown and the base yellowish brown; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow. The whole body covered with soft hairs. Head oval, the frons sloping gradually forwards, longer than wide, widest at the middle of the head; fontanelle indistinct; the boundary between the frons and the postclypeus distinct, the postclypeus slightly transparent. Labrum lingulate, widest at the base, narrowing gradually towards the apex, with about seven long bristles on each side. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices incurved, shorter than the head; the left marginal tooth at one-quarter from the apex, with a small tooth near the base; the right mandible with a minute tooth at the corresponding position on the inner margin. Antennae with 15–16 segments, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 less than half of segment 1, segment 3 equal to or shorter than segment 2, segment 4 the shortest, the segments from the fifth onwards gradually clavate, the terminal segment oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head, the anterior half narrow and upturned, its anterior margin with a distinct median notch, the posterior half broader, the posterior margin arcuate and slightly concave at the middle. Legs slender; tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
